name: pr-self-employment-tax-2025
description: Puerto Rico federal self-employment tax reference for 2025 earnings and 2026 filing. Explains why the Puerto Rico-source federal income exclusion does not remove the separate social security and Medicare calculation. Covers Form 1040-SS and Schedule SE, the net-earnings threshold, the 92.35 percent adjustment, combined wage cap, Medicare component and additional Medicare thresholds. Includes examples with and without employee wages and distinguishes the filing extension from payment. Local income tax, employer payroll obligations, special occupations, optional methods and independent accountant review remain outside this source-cited draft.
